title: LEAP: Efficient LLM Inference Scheduling with Generalizable Length Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.41359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Length-aware scheduling reduces request latency in LLM serving by prioritizing shorter requests. However, despite their large model sizes, length predictors can suffer degraded ranking performance under domain and task shifts, and adapting them can require costly retraining. Their prediction overhead can further offset the benefits of scheduling. To improve the generalization and efficiency of length-aware scheduling, we propose \textbf{LEAP}, a length prediction system with fast online adaptation and asynchronous CPU execution. LEAP reuses the serving model's prefill hidden states, which contain information about the output length, and extracts this signal through a linear readout. To adapt to substantial domain and task shifts, it updates the readout at test time through recursive least squares, using completed requests as supervision without gradient computation or historical-data replay. Prediction and updates run asynchronously on C

translated_title: LEAP：具备可泛化长度预测的高效LLM推理调度
translated_abstract: 长度感知调度通过优先处理较短的请求来降低LLM服务中的请求延迟。然而，尽管长度预测器模型规模庞大，它们在领域和任务分布偏移下仍可能出现排序性能下降的问题，而对其进行适配往往需要代价高昂的重新训练。此外，预测本身的开销还可能抵消调度带来的收益。为了提升长度感知调度的泛化性与效率，我们提出了LEAP——一个具备快速在线适配和异步CPU执行能力的长度预测系统。LEAP复用服务模型预填充阶段的隐藏状态（其中蕴含输出长度信息），并通过一个线性读取头提取该信号。为适应显著的领域和任务分布偏移，LEAP在测试阶段利用递归最小二乘法更新读取头，以已完成的请求作为监督信号，无需梯度计算或历史数据回放。预测与更新过程在CPU上异步运行。
tldr: LEAP通过复用LLM服务模型预填充阶段的隐藏状态，并以递归最小二乘法在线适配线性读取头实现快速、低开销且可泛化的输出长度预测，从而显著提升长度感知推理调度的效率与跨领域适应能力。
en_tdlr: LEAP achieves efficient and generalizable LLM output length prediction by reusing prefill hidden states with a linear readout adapted online via recursive least squares, enhancing length-aware inference scheduling under domain and task shifts.
